sources.quote: As a result of our efficiency improvements, we are also lowering the price of these models to $2 / 1M input tokens and $10 / 1M output tokens.
sources.supports: xAI's launch announcement states the official input and output rates for grok-2-1212.
xAI's billing reference shows a prompt-token billing line for grok-2-1212 in its February 2025 invoice example, consistent with $2 per million input tokens.
The same invoice example records completion-token billing at the rate corresponding to $10 per million output tokens.
xAI's model configuration lists a zero cached-prompt rate and the normal prompt and completion rates; it has no separate cache-write price.
xAI's model configuration identifies grok-2-1212 as not supporting reasoning, which weighs against treating the removed cache_write value as a provider price change for reasoning.

notes: The provider evidence supports $2 input and $10 output; its model configuration shows cached prompts priced at zero and no separate cache-write rate, so the recorded cache_write value of $10 appears to have been a models.dev data error. The Internet Archive CDX endpoint returned HTTP 503, so no archive snapshot pair was available; no effective date is asserted.
